notes.title: Our game is finally released!
notes.content:
We have a big reason to celebrate today.

And we waited!

And we survived!

And we didn't gave up!

And we didn't switch to the other project!

[h3]Captain Gazman Day Of The Rage is OFICIALLY RELEASED![/h3]

Thanks to all who were with us during all that hard time, and to all, who were with us, but at the end are not here ([spoiler]like my dad, 1960-2023, and my brother, 1982-2024[/spoiler])!

You're the best community we ever had! 
[spoiler]You're thunder on the highway, looking bad, bad, bad![/spoiler]
[spoiler]that's a Dukes of Hazzard reference[/spoiler]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]

Our next game is Seema's Revenge, and it will be released on April 30th, 2025. You can try a prototype of it in the DLC menu of the main game.

Captain Gazman 2 (working subtitles - Rocks Of The Fate, Cliffs Of The Fate and Dawn Of The Rage) will need a much bigger budget than the first game (110,000$ vs. 7500$), so don't expect any news about it in the near future.
[spoiler]Documents mention the release year for this sequel -  [b]2031[/b]. Really?[/spoiler] 


First DLC - The Legend Of 1970, featuring 2-player cooperative as Frederick and Renee. Will be released on June 12th, 2025, and we even have some stuff to show already on our hands!

notes.title: What about the Steam Deck compatability?
notes.content:
[h2]Requirement 1: Input[/h2]

[list]
[*] The game must support Steam Deck's physical controls, but in a somewhat unorthodoxal way - we're using one of the gamepad sticks as a virtual cursor.
[*] You can get 99% of the game content with a controller (excluding one mini-game which is gonna be skipped if the controller is plugged in and some keyboard-only cheats).
[*] Controller glyphs are working right - the default ones are from Xbox One.
[*] This game has built-in virtual keyboards in moments where you need them.
[/list]

[h2]Requirement 2: Display[/h2]

[list]
[*] 1280x720 and 1280x800 resolutions are supported here.
[*] Default settings are configured for 30 FPS, but you can get 60/120 by lowering them.
[*] Interface texts are readable enough, they were optimized for the consoles previously.
[/list]

[h3]Requirement 3: Seamlessness[/h3]

[list]
[*] No incompatibility warnings (game will not scream at you if something is gone horribly wrong).
[*] We have no external programs/launchers/other garbage.
[/list]

[h3]Requirement 4: Proton Requirements[/h3]

Not tested (we have a native port).
